compose.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the new-post sheet. The draft is kept.

compose.completion.suggestions.description: Accessible name of the list of suggestions that opens under the text of a post, a content warning or a profile while the user types a mention after @, a hashtag after # or an emoji after : (ADR-0092).

compose.completion.count.description: Announced to screen readers when the list of suggestions for the typed mention, hashtag or emoji opens or changes. {count} is how many suggestions it shows.

compose.completion.loading.description: Shown in the place of the suggestions, and announced, while the suggestions for the typed mention or hashtag take a moment to arrive.

compose.completion.empty.description: Shown in the place of the suggestions, and announced, when nothing matches the typed mention, hashtag or emoji.

compose.completion.tag_posts.description: How many public posts carry a hashtag, shown after the hashtag in the list of suggestions while the user types a hashtag. {count} is the number of posts.

compose.failed.description: Error after publishing a post failed. The draft is kept. {reason} is the error message.

compose.language.label.description: Label of the choice of the language a post is written in.

compose.language.und.description: Choice of post language when the user does not say which language the post is in.

compose.media.add.description: Button that opens the file picker to attach images, a video, or an audio file to a post.

compose.media.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# file attached} other {# files attached}}
compose.media.count.description: Description of the button that attaches media, while the post has some. {count} is how many files.

compose.media.description.hint.defaultMessage: Describe it for people who cannot see or hear it.
compose.media.description.hint.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file.

compose.media.description.label.description: Label of the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.description.required.defaultMessage: Describe it for people who cannot see or hear it. Your settings ask for a description of every attachment.
compose.media.description.required.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attachment when the user's settings ask for a description of every attachment.

compose.media.description.server_require.defaultMessage: Describe it for people who cannot see or hear it. This server requires a description of every attachment.
compose.media.description.server_require.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file when the server requires a description of every image (the instance setting require_media_description).

compose.media.description.missing.defaultMessage: Add a description of this attachment. This server requires one for every attachment.
compose.media.description.missing.description: Error of the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file that has no description while the server requires one for every image.

compose.media.failed.description: State of an attached file whose upload failed. {reason} is the error message.

compose.media.failed_processing.defaultMessage: The server could not process this file.
compose.media.failed_processing.description: Why an attached file failed: the server could not process it.

compose.media.hint.defaultMessage: Up to {max, plural, other {# files}}: JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP images, MP4 or WebM video, or MP3, Ogg, or M4A audio. Location and other metadata are removed.
compose.media.hint.description: Help text next to the button that attaches media. {max} is the most files a post can have. JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP4, WebM, MP3, Ogg, M4A are format names (not translated).

compose.media.list.description: Accessible name of the list of images, videos, and audio files attached to the post being written.

compose.media.processing.description: State of an attached file while the server prepares it.

compose.media.remove.description: Button that removes an attached file from the post. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.too_many.defaultMessage: A post can have at most {max, plural, other {# files}}. The rest were not added.
compose.media.too_many.description: Notice when the user picked more files than a post can have. {max} is the most files a post can have.

compose.media.unsupported.defaultMessage: {name} is not a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image, an MP4 or WebM video, or an MP3, Ogg, or M4A audio file.
compose.media.unsupported.description: Notice when a picked file is not a type the server accepts. {name} is the file name. The format names are not translated.

compose.media.uploading.description: State of an attached file while it is being sent to the server.

compose.mention.unreached.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {{accounts} is on another server and does not follow you, so they will not receive this post. Outside this server, “This server” posts reach only your followers, who see this mention as a plain link.} other {{accounts} are on other servers and do not follow you, so they will not receive this post. Outside this server, “This server” posts reach only your followers, who see these mentions as plain links.}}
compose.mention.unreached.description: Warning under a post with the visibility 'This server' that mentions accounts of other servers that do not follow the author (ADR-0017, ADR-0035): those accounts do not receive the post, and the author's followers on other servers see the mention as a plain link, not as a mention. {accounts} is the list of their handles, for example '@carol@remote.example and @dave@other.example'; {count} is how many there are.

compose.federation.stays_local.defaultMessage: This won't reach other servers: this server does not send posts to them now, so the accounts of other servers that this replies to or mentions will not receive it.
compose.federation.stays_local.description: Warning under a post that replies to or mentions an account of another server while this server sends nothing to other servers (federation direction 'Receive only' or 'Off', ADR-0076).

compose.missing_description.add.description: Button of the confirmation that goes back to the form to describe the images.

compose.missing_description.body.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# image has no description.} other {# images have no description.}} People who cannot see the images will not know what they show.
compose.missing_description.body.description: Text of the confirmation about images without a description. {count} is how many images have none.

compose.missing_description.post.description: Button of the confirmation that posts without the descriptions.

compose.missing_description.title.description: Title of the confirmation shown when attached images have no description and the user's settings ask for one.

compose.open.description: The coral button in the phones' tab bar and the button in the side rail that open the form for a new post. In the compact rail (tablets) only its icon shows and this is its accessible name; keep it short.

compose.outbox.discard.description: Button that throws away a post that could not be sent.

compose.outbox.edit.description: Button that puts a post that could not be sent back into the form.

compose.outbox.failed.description: State of a post that could not be sent. {reason} is the error message.

compose.outbox.label.description: Accessible name of the list of posts that are being sent or could not be sent.

compose.outbox.retry.description: Button that sends a post that could not be sent again.

compose.outbox.sending.description: State of a post that is being sent.

compose.outbox.unsent.description: State of a post whose sending was interrupted (for example by reloading the page).

compose.over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character too many} other {# characters too many}}
compose.over.description: Counter under a text field when the text is longer than allowed. {count} is how many characters are over.

compose.poll.toggle.description: Toggle button (an icon) that adds a poll to the new post, or removes it. A post with a poll attaches no files.

compose.poll.legend.description: Name of the group of fields of the poll of the new post: its options, how long it lasts, and its settings.

compose.poll.option.description: Label of a text field of the poll of the new post: one option the readers can vote for. {number} is its position, from 1.

compose.poll.option.remove.description: Button (an icon) that removes an option of the poll of the new post. {number} is its position, from 1.

compose.poll.option.add.description: Button that adds an empty option to the poll of the new post.

compose.poll.duplicate.description: Error under the options of the poll of the new post when two of them are the same.

compose.poll.duration.description: Label of the select of how long the poll of the new post takes votes.

compose.poll.duration.minutes.description: Option of how long a poll takes votes. {count} is a number of minutes.

compose.poll.duration.hours.description: Option of how long a poll takes votes. {count} is a number of hours.

compose.poll.duration.days.description: Option of how long a poll takes votes. {count} is a number of days.

compose.poll.multiple.description: Checkbox of the poll of the new post: a vote may choose several options.

compose.poll.hide_totals.defaultMessage: Hide the votes until the poll ends
compose.poll.hide_totals.description: Checkbox of the poll of the new post: nobody sees the votes of each option until the poll ends.

compose.posted.description: Notice after a post was published.

compose.remaining.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
compose.remaining.description: Counter under a text field: how many more characters fit. {count} is a number.

compose.reply.cancel.description: Button that turns the reply being written into a normal post.

compose.reply.label.description: Above the new-post form: the post being replied to. {name} is the author's display name or handle.

compose.reply.unavailable.defaultMessage: The post you are replying to cannot be shown.
compose.reply.unavailable.description: Shown instead of the post being replied to when it could not be loaded.

compose.sensitive.defaultMessage: Hide the images until readers show them
compose.sensitive.description: Checkbox that marks the attached images as sensitive.

compose.submit.description: Button that publishes the new post.

compose.submit.reply.description: Button that publishes the reply being written.

compose.text.label.description: Label of the text area where the user writes the text of a post.

compose.title.description: Heading of the form that writes a new post (the side panel on wide screens, the sheet on phones).

compose.visibility.button.description: Button that opens the choice of who can see the post. {visibility} is the current choice, for example 'Public'.

compose.visibility.ceiling.defaultMessage: Your account can post at most as “{visibility}” right now. A wider choice is posted as “{visibility}”.
compose.visibility.ceiling.description: Hint in the choice of visibility while a restriction on the account narrows what it can post. {visibility} is the widest visibility it can use, for example 'Followers'.

compose.visibility.direct.description: Visibility of a post: only the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.done.description: Button that closes the list of visibility choices.

compose.visibility.limited.defaultMessage: Posted with the visibility “{visibility}”: your account cannot post more widely right now.
compose.visibility.limited.description: Notice after posting when the server narrowed the chosen visibility because of a restriction on the account. {visibility} is the visibility the post got, for example 'Followers'.

compose.visibility.local.description: Visibility of a post: signed-in people of this server and the author's followers. Not the same as 'local only' in other software: followers on other servers receive it.

compose.visibility.local.description.defaultMessage: People signed in here, and your followers on other servers. Shown on this server's local timeline.

compose.visibility.private.description: Visibility of a post: the author's followers and the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.private.description.defaultMessage: Only your followers and the people you mention.

compose.visibility.public.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, and listed on the public timelines.

compose.visibility.public.description.defaultMessage: Anyone, here and on other servers. Shown on the public timelines.

compose.visibility.title.description: Label of the list of visibility choices for a post.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, but kept off the public timelines.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description.defaultMessage: Anyone with the link, but not shown on the public timelines.

compose.warning.description.defaultMessage: Readers see this first and choose whether to show the post.
compose.warning.description.description: Help text under the content warning field.

compose.warning.label.description: Label of the field with the content warning text of a post.

compose.warning.toggle.description: Toggle button (an icon) that adds a content warning: a short text shown instead of the post until the reader opens it.

compose.quote.label.description: Heading above the new-post form of the post being quoted. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of its author.

compose.quote.cancel.description: Button under the post being quoted in the new-post form; the draft then quotes nothing.

compose.quote.unavailable.defaultMessage: The post to quote could not be loaded.
compose.quote.unavailable.description: Shown in place of the post being quoted in the new-post form when it could not be loaded.

compose.quote_policy.label.description: Accessible name of the select in the new-post form that chooses who may quote the post.

compose.quote_policy.public.description: Quote policy: anyone who can see the post may quote it.

compose.quote_policy.public.description.defaultMessage: Anyone who can see the post can quote it.

compose.quote_policy.followers.description: Quote policy: only the author's followers may quote the post.

compose.quote_policy.followers.descripti.defaultMessage: Only your followers can quote it.

compose.quote_policy.nobody.description: Quote policy: only the author may quote the post.

compose.quote_policy.nobody.description.defaultMessage: Nobody but you can quote it.
compose.quote_policy.nobody.description.description: Description of the quote policy 'Only you'.

compose.quote_policy.tooltip.description: Tooltip of the select that chooses who may quote the post, shown on hover and keyboard focus. {value} is the current choice, for example 'Followers'.

compose.language.tooltip.description: Tooltip of the select that chooses the language of the post, shown on hover and keyboard focus. {value} is the current language, for example 'English'.
